newsitem.title: PERU: Peru says July yr-on-yr GDP growth 5.1 percent.
newsitem.headline: Peru says July yr-on-yr GDP growth 5.1 percent.

text.p: Peru's year-on-year Gross Domestic Product (GDP) growth was 5.1 percent in July, compared with a 7.4 percent figure for the same month last year, President Alberto Fujimori said Monday.
Fujimori, in a speech to a Peruvian-Japanese business forum, did not give the year-on-year GDP growth rate for the first seven months.
The government is predicting growth of between three and four percent this year, down from initial projections of five to six percent due to an economic slowdown.
In 1995, the economy expanded 7.0 percent, Latin America's second-highest growth rate, down from 13.1 percent in 1994, according to revised central bank figures.
